caption: The drawing features a single, long-sleeved dress as its primary object. The dress is depicted in a reddish-brown color with a prominent black floral and scrollwork pattern covering the entirety of the fabric. The sleeves are wide and slightly flared at the ends. The bodice is fitted with a defined waistline that expands into a full, bell-shaped skirt. At the neckline, there is a white, triangular lace collar. The dress is centered on a plain, light background. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, unfinished line sketch of the same dress, viewed from the back, providing detail on the garment’s construction and how the pattern is distributed. The composition is uncluttered, with all attention focused on the detailed rendering of the dress.
title: Dress
